project.name: Shipping calculator
project.notes: Project discovered and analyzed. Features categorized based on existing codebase.

features.title: Vehicle Management
features.description: CRUD operations for user vehicles, including setting types, categories, and managing lists.
acceptance_criteria: Vehicles can be added, updated, and deleted.
Vehicles are categorized (e.g., Moped, Shuttle).
User vehicles are persistent via Room database.
features.notes: Core data model and repository are fully implemented.

features.title: Delivery Cost Calculation
features.description: Core feature to calculate estimated delivery costs based on vehicle type, distance, and fuel consumption.
acceptance_criteria: Calculation logic is implemented and uses appropriate models (`DeliveryCalculation`, `CostBreakdown`).
The main screen (`CalculatorScreen`) successfully displays results.
verification: Manual verification against expected mathematical outputs
features.notes: This is the primary business logic of the application.

features.title: Maintenance Logging
features.description: Allow users to log maintenance records for their vehicles (e.g., oil changes, tire rotations).
acceptance_criteria: Maintenance records can be added and retrieved via `MaintenanceRepository`.
Maintenance history is displayed in a dedicated screen/list.
Data is persisted correctly using Room.
verification: Unit tests for maintenance Use Cases

features.title: Calculation History
features.description: Save and retrieve historical delivery calculation results for later review.
acceptance_criteria: The application maintains a history of past calculations.
History data is retrieved and displayed in a dedicated UI screen.
features.notes: Implements long-term data tracking for user use.

features.title: User Settings Management
features.description: Manage application-wide settings such as preferred fuel types or calculation preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Settings can be read and written persistently (`SettingsEntity`).
Settings affect calculation logic.
verification: Testing settings impact on cost calculation
features.notes: Uses a dedicated Room entity and repository for settings.

features.title: Usage Analytics
features.description: Track and display statistics related to application usage and calculated data.
acceptance_criteria: Usage statistics can be collected.
The `AnalyticsScreen` successfully fetches and displays data.

features.title: Calculation Modes Implementation (NEW)
features.description: Introduce a toggle between 'Simple' and 'Advanced' modes to control UI and calculation complexity.
acceptance_criteria: A toggle UI is implemented in `CalculatorScreen`.
State management switches all related use cases (F001-F006) between their Simple and Advanced implementations based on the toggle state.
features.notes: This is the orchestrating task for the entire feature set.

features.title: Share Delivery Quote / Commercial Offer (PDF & Text)
features.description: Export and share formatted delivery cost receipts, commercial offers, or PDF/image summaries directly to messaging apps (Telegram, WhatsApp, etc.).
acceptance_criteria: A 'Share Quote / Поделиться сметой' action is accessible from calculation result view and history items.
Generates formatted text message with route details, distance, total cost, and delivery date.
Allows exporting/sharing receipt image or PDF with custom branding/watermark.
Launches Android System Share Sheet with Telegram, WhatsApp, and other installed messaging options.
verification: Unit tests for quote text and document formatting logic
UI verification of Share intent triggering
features.notes: Enhances driver-client communication and drives viral app discovery.
